companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.value:
Hengshui Kangyuan Rubber and Plastic Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 1995 and is located in the Rubber Industrial Park of Jing County, Hebei Province. It is a modern new-type enterprise specializing in the production of pneumatic construction machinery tires, pneumatic forklift tires, solid construction machinery tires, solid forklift tires, and agricultural machinery tires. The company covers an area of over 300 acres, with a building area of 86,000 square meters. It employs 360 staff members and 42 technical personnel, including 10 engineers. With total assets of 500 million yuan, the company has an annual production capacity of 800,000 construction machinery tires and forklift tires.
The construction machinery tires produced by our company exhibit high-performance braking, safety, and comfort; they are characterized by wear resistance, high temperature resistance, cutting resistance, and puncture resistance. Additionally, they possess vibration prevention and noise reduction capabilities, and offer environmental benefits such as low investment costs, easy assembly and disassembly, no need for studs or chains, reduced dust and noise.
Currently, our company has established a comprehensive sales network in China, and the domestic market for construction machinery tires is in short supply. Our products have won widespread praise from dealers for their stable quality and good reputation. While developing the domestic market, the company continues to expand into foreign markets. With independent import and export rights, our products are currently exported to more than 20 countries and regions in Southeast Asia, South America, and the Middle East.
